references.text: The Lord afflicted Pharaoh and his household with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife
Abimelech sees Isaac caressing Rebekah and realizes she is his wife—a parallel situation where a patriarch passes off his wife as his sister
God came to the Aramean Laban in a dream at night and said to him: Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad
He allowed no one to oppress them, and rebuked kings on their behalf: Do not touch my anointed ones, and do no harm to my prophets
In dreams, in visions of the night, when deep sleep falls upon people as they slumber on their beds, then he opens their ears and seals his instruction over them
Repetition of the same event and motif (the lie about wife/sister) in a later generation.
The consequence of God's warning: Abimelech's enactment of protective law for the innocent.
